title: Illusion of Fate
next_chapter_hook: Can Chen Ji find a way to break the deadlock before the seventh day of the third month? And how will the figure imprisoned in the Holy Sect respond to her brother's arrival?

text.content:
As Ling Yuan's figure vanished completely into the night, the Tianji Record in Chen Ji's hands suddenly shook violently—the fourth page was turning by itself.

An immense and ancient aura poured from the fragment, and Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his brow center, as if some invisible giant hand was tearing at his spirit soul. He instinctively wanted to close the pages, but found the page seemed to have taken root, impossible to close.

At the same time, a cold voice echoed through the void—an ancient being's remnant consciousness fragment had sensed the Tianji Record's disturbance and was tracking it down.

Chen Ji felt a chill in his heart, sensing danger.

He instinctively poured all his spiritual consciousness into the Tianji Record, attempting to suppress that uncontrolled power. However, the fourth page seemed to possess its own will, stubbornly turning, and faint patterns began to emerge on the paper like a dried riverbed awaiting rain.

"Foolish ants..." the cold voice rang out again, carrying ancient coldness, "Did you think the Tianji Record was something you could meddle with?"

An invisible force suddenly pressed down, and Chen Ji let out a muffled grunt as blood seeped from the corner of his mouth. His internal organs felt like they were being gripped by an invisible giant hand, ready to burst at any moment.

dialogue.content:
Cough... If you want to take my life, at least show some real skill!

(Chen Ji forced himself to stand upright, blood staining the corner of his mouth, but his gaze remained as cold and sharp as ever—he had never bowed to any existence, even if that being was ancient beyond measure.)

text.content:
The ancient being seemed enraged by this ant's audacity, and an even more boundless pressure crashed down.

Chen Ji felt the world spinning around him, his knees going weak as he knelt on the ground. His consciousness began to blur, and the scenes before his eyes fractured into pieces. However, just as he was about to lose consciousness, the fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with blinding golden light—a warm force surged into his spirit soul, pulling him back from the edge of collapse.

At the same time, a blurry vision gradually unfolded before his eyes—

It was endless darkness.

In the darkness, a slender figure hung suspended in the void by countless chains. The chains emanated a诡异的 purple glow, each one carved with dense, intricate runes that firmly sealed all the meridians of that figure.

Chen Ji's heart contracted sharply—that figure, though its features were blurred by the darkness, the familiar silhouette, the connection刻在骨血里的感应, made him instantly recognize the person.

It was Nian Nian.

His sister, Chen Nian.

dialogue.content:
(The imprisoned figure seemed to sense something, slowly lifting its head. On that blurry face, a pair of eyes shone异常清澈, as if piercing through endless darkness, directly gazing toward where Chen Ji was.)

...Brother... is that you...

(That voice was as faint as a mosquito's whine, yet it thundered in Chen Ji's heart like a sudden clap.)

text.content:
Chen Ji's eyes instantly moistened.

How many years had it been? He had spent countless nights tossing and turning, the scene of that stormy night constantly replaying in his mind—his sister being taken away, and he could do nothing. At that time, he had been too weak, too weak to even have the qualification to resist.

All these years, he had disguised himself as a废物, surviving in the cracks, doing everything for the day when he could find her again.

And now, she was right before his eyes. Even if just a phantom, even if just a blurry silhouette, he had finally truly sensed her existence.

Just then, the ancient being's attack came again.

Chen Ji felt a tearing, excruciating pain from the depths of his spirit soul, and the vision before him began to twist violently, as if it would dissipate at any moment. His consciousness wavered between reality and illusion, his body swaying precariously.

If he could not make a decision, either he would be completely devoured by that ancient being, turning into nothingness; or he would wake from this vision, missing this sole connection with his sister.

This was a life-and-death choice—

choice.prompt: At the edge of life and death, Chen Ji must make a choice. Stay in the vision to glimpse his sister's silhouette a moment longer, or forcefully break free and return to reality?

choices.description: Even if there was only a thread of hope, he would stay in this vision, wanting to see his sister's face clearly, to hear her voice. This was the clue he had desperately sought for years.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain Complete Location Information of Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: The ancient being's attack will take the opportunity to intensify, and the spirit soul may suffer irreversible damage

text.content:
Chen Ji clenched his teeth, pouring all his spiritual consciousness into that vision.

The intense pain came like a tide, but he死死地守住了最后一丝意识, refusing to let the ancient being drag him into the abyss. The vision gradually cleared before his eyes—

choices.description: Reason told him that he must survive to save his sister. He had to return to reality, grow stronger, and then come back for her.
choices.visible_reward: Spirit Soul Stabilized, Ancient Being's Attack Temporarily Repelled
choices.risk_hint: The vision may dissipate completely, and Chen Nian's location information will become blurred and unclear

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to leave the vision.

The tearing pain almost ripped his spirit soul to pieces, but he grit his teeth, with great willpower dragging his consciousness back to reality. The vision dissolved quickly before his eyes, but in that last glance, he saw the smile appearing on his sister's face—

No matter what choice Chen Ji made, the ancient being seemed determined not to let him go.

A jet-black rift tore open in the void, and a claw formed from pure destructive power extended out, directly reaching for Chen Ji's crown. If this strike landed, he would certainly die.

At this critical moment, the fourth page of the Tianji Record suddenly burst forth with dazzling brilliance—the final strand of power sealed within Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul was now automatically activated, forming a golden barrier before Chen Ji.

dialogue.content:
(The golden barrier blocked the lethal strike, but the aura of Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul dimmed correspondingly. His voice emerged from the book pages, aged and weary.)

Kid... the trouble you've gotten into this time is far greater than I imagined...

(After a pause, as if making some kind of confirmation.)

Though... you saw her, didn't you?

(Chen Ji gripped the Tianji Record tightly, his knuckles white from the force. His voice was somewhat hoarse, yet carried an unwavering resolve.)

She's at the Holy Sect... Heavenly Fate Lock Key... I'll go rescue her, regardless of any cost.

(His gaze turned deep and terrifying - that was the true fangs hidden beneath the guise of a废物.)

Whoever dares obstruct me, I'll make them accompany Niannian to the grave.

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng remained silent for a long while before sighing.

Heavenly Fate Lock Key... That's the Holy Sect's most core forbidden technique. That child Nian was chosen, not because of her exceptional talent, but because her blood carries the Chen family's direct lineage - it's the key to opening a certain gate.

(His voice turned heavy.)

March seventh, when Heavenly Fates converge. The Holy Sect will hold a grand sacrifice, using Niannian's bloodline to open that forbidden gate. If she can't be rescued before then...

(He didn't finish, but the implication was clear.)

Chen Ji listened quietly, his expression unchanged.

But if one looked closely, they would notice his fingers gripping the Tianji Record trembling slightly - not from fear, nor anger, but an emotion suppressed to the extreme seeking an outlet.

He slowly closed his eyes, silently calculating the time in his heart.

From now until March seventh, there were less than three months. Within these three months, he needed to do many things - enhance his strength, lay out contingencies, disrupt the Holy Sect's formation, find a way to infiltrate their forbidden grounds...

And before all that, he first had to survive and leave this place.

choice.prompt: Although the ancient existence's attack was temporarily repelled, the rift remained. Mo Xiansheng's power was nearly depleted, and Chen Ji had to decide his next move.

choices.description: She is the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, with exceptional Combat Power. If she can arrive in time, perhaps together they can repel this ancient existence.
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao might further inquire about the secrets of the Tianji Record

text.content:
Chen Ji took out a communication jade talisman from his chest and crushed it. Su Qingyao had given him one before, saying he could contact her in times of danger - though she probably didn't expect him to use it so soon.

The moment the jade talisman shattered, a beam of azure light shot into the sky, blooming into a magnificent fireworks display against the night sky.

Meanwhile, the ancient existence's attacks grew increasingly ferocious, with cracks beginning to appear on the golden barrier.

choices.description: Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist can conceal the aura of the Tianji Record. If we can sever the connection between the ancient existence and the Tianji Record, perhaps we can seize the opportunity to escape.
choices.visible_cost: Consume the alliance bargain with Ye Qing
choices.visible_reward: Break free from the ancient existence's pursuit
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing's ability is limited, only able to delay for a moment

text.content:
Chen Ji took out a pitch-black jade slip from his storage bag - it was a lifeline Ye Qing had given him before parting, reputed to be able to shroud all Heavenly Secrets' inductions.

Without hesitation, he poured his Spiritual Energy into it. A dense, nearly tangible black mist erupted from his palm, instantly enveloping both him and the Tianji Record.

The ancient existence's attack immediately lost its accuracy, probing endlessly at the edge of the black mist but never able to touch Chen Ji's true form.

choices.description: Depend on no one, use one's own hidden trump cards to fight a bloody path out. The reputation of being a废物 might just be the best cover.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a large number of Tianji Record foresight uses

text.content:
Chen Ji sneered coldly, pulling out a stack of talisman papers from his chest - those were essentials he'd collected over time for disciples' servants to escape, appearing inferior but actually hiding profound mechanisms.

He activated all the talismans at once, causing a burst of dust and smoke to explode behind him. Simultaneously, his figure flickered and he darted like a phantom into the depths of the dense forest.

The ancient existence howled in pursuit, but quickly lost his trail - in its eyes, the aura of a Servant Disciple was simply too weak and insignificant.

The night was as black as ink, cold wind howling.

Chen Ji didn't know how long he'd been running until the ancient existence's oppressive pressure completely vanished from his perception. Only then did he stop, leaning against an ancient tree, gasping heavily.

His condition was terrible - spirit damaged, qi and blood in reverse, Spiritual Energy nearly depleted. But his eyes were brighter than ever.

Because finally, he had a clear objective.

Niannian, wait for me a little longer.

Brother will definitely come to rescue you.

(He slowly closed his eyes, in his mind linking together all the information obtained tonight. Heavenly Fate Lock Key, Holy Sect forbidden grounds, March seventh, Heavenly Fate convergence... Each keyword was drawing an increasingly clear picture in his heart.)

This time, he was no longer that helpless waste youth who could only watch his sister being taken away.

He would make the entire world, a chess piece on his board.

The Tianji Record in Chen Ji's embrace glowed faintly warm, seemingly responding to its master's determination.

The fourth page had been completely turned, but its contents remained blurry and unclear, as if certain conditions needed to be met for it to fully manifest. Chen Ji knew it was a deliberate restriction left by Mo Xiansheng - knowing too much sometimes wasn't a good thing.

But that was fine.

When he needed to know, he would naturally know. What mattered most now was to survive, grow stronger, and then rescue Niannian.

The night breeze brushed past, carrying away the remnants of battle. Tianqing Sect's lights flickered in the distance, as if waiting for its master to return. Chen Ji took a deep breath, stumbling to his feet, and walked toward the opposite direction -

There, a bigger chess game was waiting for him.
